about.intro: I studied architecture before moving into professional 3D visualization. Over time, I also got deeper into development by building web tools and automations to solve practical workflow problems. Today my work combines visual production and technical systems, depending on what the project needs.

description: Led a 3D modeling production team delivering high-volume architectural visualization for international clients.
Owned workflow coordination, quality standards, and technical troubleshooting across the full production pipeline.
Served as the key liaison between production teams and management during peak-volume periods.
Delivered high-volume architectural visualization outputs — modeling, rendering, and post-processing — across tight client turnaround schedules.
Maintained consistent quality across large SketchUp and VRay pipeline batches under sustained production pressure.
Contributed to Unity-based workflows covering asset preparation, geometry optimization, and game-ready production pipeline structures.
